key_terms: An open protocol from the Delta Lake project under the Linux Foundation, not the Apache Software Foundation, through which a recipient discovers and reads shared tables.
The top-level object a provider grants to a recipient, containing schemas that contain shared tables.
The party granted access to shares, identified by the credentials in its profile file.
A JSON file holding the sharing server endpoint, a bearer token and the profile format version.
The Scala and JVM server implementation intended for development and interoperability testing, not a production deployment.
evidence: Actual portable basic-Parquet protocol client plus separately prepared native Scala reference-server/table-store route. No local server, advanced Delta/CDF or unsupported ARM feature acceptance is inferred.
